title: The Quiet Coast
premise: A night-shift baker survives the night the sea swallowed his city, then follows a signal light inland to find out who else made it, and who knew it was coming.

hero.name: Ravi
hero.trait: keeps going when he is scared

world: A seaside city at the foot of forested hills with an old radio tower.
arc: The quake and the wave: Ravi survives by climbing the radio tower.
Following the signal light through a burning, storm-soaked forest to a stranger who knows his name.
The stranger is the tower's keeper, who saw the wave coming hours early, and why no warning was sent.
tone: tense, cinematic, hopeful by the end
